answer: Give standing only for work merged into shared public projects, each merge approved by a maintainer from a different circle. A newcomer starts on the lowest knoll of trust and climbs by fixing real bugs or adding real features that strangers actually accept, with every merge recorded in a public atlas of who approved what. A farm of fakes collapses like a karst sinkhole, because each fake needs genuine accepted work reviewed by maintainers it does not control, and a rejected merge costs the sponsor's standing too. Honest merges compound season after season; copied work earns nothing.
